ingredients.tip: Save a splash of the brine

steps.text: Blend the herbs, avocado, lemon, garlic, capers, and a splash of water until vivid green.
Warm the beans gently with olive oil, salt, and a spoonful of caper brine.
Toast the sourdough hard enough to scrape with a garlic clove.
Fold the green sauce through the warm beans and pile over toast.
